record_scope_reconstruction: Guatemalan truck drivers blocked road access on the Melchor side to cargo entering Belize from Tuesday 31 August until trucks resumed around 11:30 on 2 September 2021. This is a freight access protest, not a closure of the entire Guatemala–Belize frontier.

source_checks.finding: Body describes Guatemala-side road blockage, 70–80 waiting trucks, Customs concession and renewed crossing at about 11:30 on 2 September.
